annotations.title: One tokenized-stock issuer: what, where, who controls it, OFAC

description: One issuer of tokenized stocks (coinbase, robinhood, xstocks, ondo, bstocks, dinari): the entity and jurisdiction as its documents name them, what it has tokenized (tokens, companies, value at its reference values), on which networks, the control addresses its contracts answer (owner, minter, burner, pauser, sanctions list, registry; Solana mint, freeze and pause authorities and any permanent delegate), holders where read, reserves where it reports them, what is paused now, the contract family’s documented powers, and an OFAC SDN exact-match screening of the control addresses with the list version. Free. No match does not rule out a sanctioned party; holders are read on Ethereum and Solana only.
